title: Northern Italy by Rail
notes: Rail passes are in the shared folder. Keep one evening free in Venice for a long dinner. Rohan needs a vegetarian meal on every booking.

days.summary: Land at Malpensa, take the express into town, see the Duomo, Last Supper slot in the afternoon.
days.weather: 22°C, sunny; light breeze in the evening
days.transit: Malpensa Express every 30 min. Metro M1 to Conciliazione for Santa Maria delle Grazie.

items.notes: Overnight departure on May 13. Seats 32A–C.
Buy tickets in the Trenord app; validate before boarding.

items.title: Duomo di Milano & rooftop terraces
items.notes: Lift tickets bought on site. Shoulders covered for the cathedral.

items.title: The Last Supper
items.address: Piazza di Santa Maria delle Grazie 2, 20123 Milano
items.notes: Arrive 20 minutes early at the ticket office to collect.

items.title: Aperitivo on the Navigli
items.notes: Try Mag Café; dinner nearby at Al Pont de Ferr if not too tired.

days.summary: Train to Lake Como, afternoon in Varenna gardens, evening cooking class.
days.weather: 19°C, scattered clouds; 20% chance of showers after 4 PM
days.transit: Regional train from Centrale (no reservation). Ferries Varenna–Bellagio every 30 min.

items.notes: Sit on the left side for lake views.

items.title: Villa Monastero gardens
items.notes: Garden-only ticket is enough.
Mid-lake day pass covers both directions.

items.title: Lunch and a walk around Bellagio
items.notes: Punta Spartivento at the tip of the promontory.

items.title: Lake Como pasta-making class
items.notes: Vegetarian menu confirmed by email.

days.summary: Long rail day to Venice, check in, Rialto and a sunset gondola.
days.transit: Vaporetto line 1 from Ferrovia to Rialto. 72-hour ACTV pass starts today.

items.notes: Coach 6, seats 9A, 9B, 10A.

items.title: Rialto Bridge and market
items.notes: Market winds down after lunch; go for the bridge views.

items.title: Sunset gondola ride
items.notes: Paid deposit; balance €60 in cash.

days.summary: Doge's Palace secret tour in the morning, then the islands.
days.weather: 23°C, sunny; hot on the lagoon after noon
days.transit: Vaporetto 4.1 from Fondamente Nove to Murano, then line 12 to Burano.

items.title: Doge's Palace Secret Itineraries
items.notes: Collect tickets at the group desk 15 minutes before.

items.title: St Mark's Basilica
items.notes: Skip-the-line booked as part of the palace bundle.

items.title: Murano glass studios
items.notes: Free demonstration at Vetreria Murano Arte.

items.title: Burano colored houses
items.notes: Dinner at Trattoria al Gatto Nero (call ahead).

days.summary: Fast train to Florence, Uffizi timed entry, sunset at Piazzale Michelangelo.
days.transit: Hotel is a 10-minute walk from S.M. Novella. Bus 12 up to Piazzale Michelangelo.

items.notes: Coach 3, seats 4A–4C.

items.title: Uffizi Gallery timed entry
items.notes: Botticelli rooms first, they get crowded later.
Taxi rank at Piazza della Repubblica.

items.title: Sunset at Piazzale Michelangelo
items.notes: Walk down through the rose garden afterwards.
